title: Canonical bundle projection normalized at the scalar unit
statement: For a commutative coefficient ring A annihilated by N, a Noetherian scheme S, and a rank-d locally free module M, the canonical coefficient-first compact-support projection for its vector bundle at the scalar unit, followed by compact support of the canonical pulled-back-unit tensor identification, equals the left unitor on the compact-support coefficient object. No trace, exceptional adjoint, inverse projection, or invertibility hypothesis is involved. All maps are exactly the published constructions of [def-trf-bundle-section-orientation-data] and [thm-amb-vector-bundle-purity].

proof.text: The single-functor constant-sheaf comparison identifies ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback with the derived monoidal unit comparison; cancel the identity scalar-unit components. Expand the coefficient-first projection into the two symmetries and ordinary projection. Naturality of braiding and the triangle identities turn the source unit comparison into the right-unit comparison. Apply projectionMap_rightUnitality, then braiding_rightUnitor. This works for rank zero, empty S and the zero coefficient ring.

theorem bundleSectionProjection_unit (N : ℕ)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (d : ℕ)
    (M : S.Modules) [M.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d] :
    vectorBundlePurityProjectionMap A N hA S d M (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S) ≫
        (vectorBundlePurityLower A S d M).map
          (bundleSectionPurityUnitIso N A hA S d M).hom =
      (derivedTensorLeftUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S
        (vectorIntegrationSource A N hA S d M)).hom
